hypothesis: Adapting only encoder layer 11 with the classifier may recover some of V2's Macro-F1 gain while retaining more of the incumbent's Dev P0 ordering than adapting both layers 10 and 11.
exactChangeFromV2: trainable encoder layers only: 10-11 -> 11 only; classifier remains trainable
finalPolicy: No Final Test file reads, inference, error inspection, tuning, or model-selection use.

training.checkpointRule: save and evaluate the final one-epoch checkpoint only

loss.bceReduction: mean over unmasked Product-18 cells within each row
loss.ranking: mean softplus(z_plausible - z_selected) over the within-row Cartesian product
loss.rowReduction: L_bce + lambdaRank * L_rank, then unweighted batch mean

stoppingAndSelectionRule: one epoch; final checkpoint only; KEEP_CANDIDATE only on all nine unchanged Dev gates, otherwise REJECT_CANDIDATE; no restart or rescue run
expectedMeasurableEffect: Dev Macro-F1 exceeds V6 while P0 raw ranking, selected-above-plausible rate, and directional selection exceed V2 without exceeding the unchanged FP allowance.
